Every finite log-odds initial state reaches [-b,a), invariant and conjugate to rotation by rho=a/(a+b); the threshold corresponds precisely to a wrap. The wrap count is an exact telescoping floor identity, the rational versus irrational dichotomy follows from rotation theory, the unique invariant density is a change of variables from Haar measure, and the derivative product telescopes along smooth itineraries. The published decimal likelihood pair is irrational by prime-11 valuations; the underlying exact fractions by prime-17 valuations. Boundary states and discontinuity hits are explicitly limited, and the extracted standalone checker verifies 3,620 exact rational identities without being used for infinite conclusions.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete solution of the anti-confirmation oscillatory regime singled out by the originating study, not an arbitrary numerical slice. It distinguishes primitive periodic orbits from dense quasiperiodicity for the same exact nonlinear Bayesian update, determines the invariant belief distribution and long-run mean, and gives a uniform error <1 for the high-belief update count at every horizon. It resolves whether the source paper’s concrete oscillations have a true finite period and provides an exactly nonchaotic reference model for assessing coupled transient dynamics.
